en: Attendant
Hello! This is Mistralton Cargo Service: quick and safe, runway to runway.
We carry passengers now, too, but the flights are up to our Gym Leader. Skyla flies when she's ready.
Would you like to board the flight to Lentimas Town?
Very well. We'll contact Skyla, so please board the plane and wait.
Of course. Come back any time!
Prof. Juniper
Hi there! Did I keep you waiting? I'm sorry! Shall we let Skyla show us her flying?
Skyla
Looks like the professor has reached a stopping point in her investigation. Are you ready to hop aboard my plane?
Ready for takeoff?
Roger! Come and talk to me when you're ready.
Prof. Juniper
All right, Skyla, we're ready. Please take us to Lentimas Town!
Bianca
Waaaait! You guys! Wait, wait, wait, wait!
Hff... pff... I want to fly, too! I want to do some research in Reversal Mountain, hff... and it's so far to walk!
Prof. Juniper
Bianca, you're here? You're starting to show the dedication of a serious researcher! Very well, everyone, off we go to Lentimas Town!
Skyla
Hee-hee! Looks like everyone's here! At last it's time to fly the Unova skies!
The little plane rolls down the runway and leaps into the wind...
Twist Mountain slides by under the wings, white where the snow lies and bare where it doesn't.
Then the plane banks over the mountain's far side, and Lentimas Town comes up to meet it.
